loreEntries.title: Vesper-Threshold: The City After Breath
loreEntries.summary: How the liminal shore of the dead became an industrial city of brass scales and ash-lamps.
loreEntries.content: When the First Seal fractured three centuries ago, the Mist-Weir slowed to a trickle. The founders of the Chancery of Scales built dikes, docks, and tallow-retorts, turning passing souls from temporary pilgrims into permanent citizens bound by ledger-debt.

loreEntries.title: The Chancery of Scales
loreEntries.summary: The ruling afterlife bureaucracy and its brass emblem.
loreEntries.content: Every Chancery vault, coin, and magistrate's seal bears the twin-panned Brass Scale. Publicly it promises order and light against the Pale Reach; privately it finances the immortal longevity elixirs of the Velvet Court.

loreEntries.title: Aether-Ash & Distilled Memory
loreEntries.summary: The luminous resource powering Vesper-Threshold's lamps and furnaces.
loreEntries.content: Residual mortal memory can be condensed into pale ash or bottled as golden vapor. While Mnemonic scholars preserve memories with consent, the Furnace Guild burns involuntary soul-tithes to keep the upper terraces glowing.

loreEntries.title: The First Seal of Quiet
loreEntries.summary: The shattered silver compact that once guaranteed peaceful passage.
loreEntries.content: Before the Chancery minted brass coins, the First Seal guided arriving souls peacefully across the Threshold. Its three broken arcs - Passage, Memory, and Quiet - were scattered across the Pale Reach to prevent anyone from restoring true rest.

loreEntries.title: The Oar-Keepers' Oath
loreEntries.summary: The neutral river wardens of Weir-Port.
loreEntries.content: The Oar-Keepers' Union predates the Chancery. Though taxed and policed by Auditors, senior ferrymen still carve miniature ashwood oars as reminders that passage was once free.

loreEntries.title: The Pale Reach (Eternal Frontier)
loreEntries.summary: The unmapped salt-swept borderland beyond Lantern-Wall Bastion.
loreEntries.content: Outside the amber glow of the Lantern-Wall stretches an endless plain of mineral salt, vitrified glass, and drifting mist-cairns where forgotten centuries overlap.

loreEntries.title: The Court of the Unwritten
loreEntries.summary: Exiled and altered souls who built a solemn kingdom in the Hollow Nave.
loreEntries.content: Chancery propaganda paints the Unwritten as feral monsters. In truth, most are former wardens, debtors, and whistleblowers cast past the Lantern-Line whose bodies hardened from raw frontier ash.

loreEntries.title: The Furnace Guild & Cinder Kilns
loreEntries.summary: The industrial syndicate controlling ash-refining and quarry labor.
loreEntries.content: Led by Furnace Baron Orlov Vane, the Guild operates colossal retorts and smoking kilns. Whistleblowers suspect the Guild inflates border casualty reports to claim extra soul-ash quotas.

loreEntries.title: The Order of the Last Bell
loreEntries.summary: Monastic bronze-casters dedicated to compassionate rest.
loreEntries.content: Casting consecrated bell-bronze in Bellwright Square, the Order rings resonant chimes that soothe tormented spirits and shelter fugitives fleeing debt-forfeiture.

loreEntries.title: The Mnemonic Collegium
loreEntries.summary: Scholars of the Glass Conservatory who safeguard identity.
loreEntries.content: Unlike the Furnace Guild, Collegium glasswrights study memory without destroying it, training arcanists to turn remembrance into protective wards and invocations.

loreEntries.title: Vow-Bound & Debt-Forged Arms
loreEntries.summary: Why weapons of the Threshold carry moral weight.
loreEntries.content: In Vesper-Threshold, metal quenched in weeping amber or condensed ash absorbs the vows and regrets of its maker, answering differently to merciful hands than to ruthless ones.

loreEntries.title: The Price of Forbidden Tollcraft
loreEntries.summary: Why the strongest Threshold spells exact a physical or moral cost.
loreEntries.content: Ordinary invocations draw on stamina and focus, but forbidden Tollcraft burns the caster's own vitality or binds their spirit to Mercy or Ruthlessness.

loreEntries.title: The Velvet Auction Court
loreEntries.summary: Where expired tallies and longevity vintages change hands.
loreEntries.content: Behind silk curtains on the Gilded Terraces, aristocratic creditors bid on unpaid soul-contracts, extending their own unaging comfort on the backs of lower-city laborers.

loreEntries.title: The Weeping Glass Orchard
loreEntries.summary: A haunting grove of translucent trees dripping amber vows.
loreEntries.content: Planted over the unmarked graves of refugees abandoned during an old Chancery purge, the orchard's trees weep glowing amber guarded by the grieving Captain Serena.

loreEntries.title: The Thirteenth Chime
loreEntries.summary: Why the Clockwork Belfry hides an unbound bronze hammer.
loreEntries.content: Twelve hammers mark Chancery labor shifts. Clockmakers whisper that a thirteenth silent hammer was locked away when High Auditor Crassus signed his secret compact with the Furnace Guild.

loreEntries.title: The Silent Architect
loreEntries.summary: The forgotten builder who designed the First Seal.
loreEntries.content: Neither god nor bureaucrat, the Silent Architect fashioned the First Seal so death would heal rather than exploit. Only an Unstamped soul can still hear the Architect's echo.

loreEntries.title: The Untaxed Hearth of Crucible Wharf
loreEntries.summary: How Master Orla Vane-Kin defied the Furnace Guild to preserve independent Threshold metallurgy.
loreEntries.content: When the Furnace Guild seized patent rights over every pale-iron smelter in Vesper-Threshold, Orla Vane-Kin broke her guild signet on her cousin's desk and dragged a salvaged brick crucible down to the fog-shrouded quay. Her motto remains chalked above the bellows: a blade stamped by debt always cuts its own bearer.

loreEntries.title: The Pre-Toll Sky & Salt-Observatory
loreEntries.summary: Before the Chancery's chimneys blackened the heavens, arrivals navigated the Pale Reach by constellations.
loreEntries.content: Old carvings at the Shattered Salt-Observatory depict three constellations: the Ferryman's Crown, the Unchained Lantern, and the Far-Shore Gate. The Chancery declared star-navigation unchartered smuggling, yet lightning still welds rare Fulgurite-Silver along the observatory's abandoned copper spires.

loreEntries.title: The Muted Bells of the Ossuary Crypt
loreEntries.summary: Why the Chancery buried a generation of consecrated bronze bells beneath lead chains.
loreEntries.content: Early Bellwright castings used a pre-Chancery alloy whose overtones dissolved ledger-curses on contact. Unable to melt the sacred bronze in ordinary kilns, High Auditors ordered the bells wrapped in lead chains, lowered into the Ossuary Crypt, and guarded by a tireless brass Bell-Mender.
